traits.text: A deep one hybrid can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: A deep one hybrid’s thick skin and dense fatty tissues grant it a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

traits.name: Final Change (Su)
traits.text: A deep one hybrid ages at the same rate as a half-orc. A mere 1d12 months after a deep one hybrid reaches venerable age (at 60 years old), it dies a painful, agonizing death, only to have its body transform into that of a mature deep one. This transformation functions as the reincarnate spell, with the newly formed deep one gaining the following modifications to its physical ability scores: +6 Strength, –2 Dexterity, and +6 Constitution.

traits.name: Sea Longing (Ex)
traits.text: Every 24 hours a deep one hybrid spends in an area more than 10 miles from the sea, it must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or take 1 point of Wisdom drain.

traits.name: Take to the Water (Ex)
traits.text: A deep one hybrid can hold its breath 10 times longer than a human can, and gains a +2 bonus on Initiative checks and Reflex saving throws while swimming. A deep one hybrid has a swim speed of 30 feet, and gains a +8 racial bonus on all Swim checks.

entries.name: Dhampir
entries.description: Dhampir: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'cha': 2, 'con': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Dhampir; Senses; Manipulative; Undead Resistance; Light Sensitivity; Negative Energy Affinity; Spell-Like Ability; Resist Level Drain.

traits.name: Dhampir
traits.text: Dhampirs are humanoids with the dhampir subtype.

traits.name: Senses
traits.text: Dhampirs get low-light vision and darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Manipulative
traits.text: Dhampirs gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Perception checks. Dhampirs of specific heritages (see below) gain a +2 bonus on different skill checks as indicated.

traits.name: Undead Resistance
traits.text: Dhampirs gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease and mind-affecting effects.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Dhampirs are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell. Dhampirs of specific heritages (see below) gain different weaknesses.

traits.name: Negative Energy Affinity
traits.text: Though they’re living creatures, dhampirs react to positive and negative energy as if they were undead; positive energy harms them, and negative energy heals them.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: A dhampir can use detect undead three times per day as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to the dhampir’s character level). Dhampirs of specific heritages (see below) gain other spell-like abilities in place of detect undead.

traits.name: Resist Level Drain
traits.text: A dhampir takes no penalties from energy drain effects, though he can still be killed if he accrues more negative levels then he has Hit Dice. After 24 hours, any negative levels a dhampir takes are removed without the need for an additional saving throw.

alternate_traits.name: Vampire Hunter
alternate_traits.description: Some dhampirs bear a deep hatred for their undead progenitors and their kin that can never be fully quenched. They gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls against vampires. This racial trait replaces manipulative.

alternate_traits.name: Vampiric Empathy
alternate_traits.description: Though dhampirs often relate poorly to humanoids, some share an affinity with baser creatures. These dhampirs gain the ability to communicate with bats, rats, and wolves as if under the effects of a spell (caster level equal to 1/2 the dhampir’s Hit Dice). In addition, they gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks when dealing with these animals. Whenever these dhampirs initiate an exchange, animals begin with a starting attitude of indifferent. This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces manipulative.

alternate_traits.name: Dayborn
alternate_traits.description: A few fortunate dhampirs were born during the day under the blessings of priests, and their blood has weaker ties to their undead bloodline than others of their kind. Such dhampirs are unhindered by daylight and lose the light sensitivity racial trait. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Fangs
alternate_traits.description: On occasion, a dhampir may inherit his father’s lengthy canines. Whenever the dhampir makes a grapple combat maneuver check to damage an opponent, he can choose to bite his opponent, dealing 1d3 points of damage as if using a natural bite attack. As a standard action, the dhampir can bite a creature that is bound, helpless, paralyzed, or similarly unable to defend itself. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Heir to Undying Nobility
alternate_traits.description: Descended from undead nobility, perhaps from an undead-ruled land, a shadow-bound land, or a haunted land, some dhampirs inherit a bit of their ancestors’ ability to control living beings. They can use command and charm person each once per day. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

entries.name: Drow
entries.description: Drow: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'cha': 2, 'con': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Elf; Darkvision; Drow Immunities; Keen Senses; Poison Use; Spell Resistance; Spell-Like Abilities; Light Blindness; Weapon Familiarity.

traits.name: Elf
traits.text: Drow are humanoids with the elf subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Drow can see in the dark up to 120 feet.

traits.name: Drow Immunities
traits.text: Drow are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Drow gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Poison Use
traits.text: Drow are skilled in the use of poison and never risk accidentally poisoning themselves.

traits.name: Spell Resistance
traits.text: A drow possesses an amount of spell resistance equal to 6 + her character level.

traits.name: Spell-Like Abilities
traits.text: A drow can cast dancing lights, darkness, and faerie fire, each once per day, using her total character level as her caster level.

traits.name: Light Blindness
traits.text: Abrupt exposure to bright light blinds drow for 1 round; on subsequent rounds, they are dazzled as long as they remain in the affected area.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Drow are proficient with the hand crossbow, rapier, and short sword.

entries.name: Drow Noble
entries.description: Drow Noble: modificatori {'dex': 4, 'int': 2, 'wis': 2, 'cha': 2, 'con': -2}, taglia None, velocita' None ft. Tratti razziali: Spell Resistance; Spell-Like Abilities.

traits.name: Spell Resistance
traits.text: Drow nobles have spell resistance equal to 11 + their character level.

traits.name: Spell-Like Abilities
traits.text: Drow nobles can cast dancing lights, deeper darkness, faerie fire, feather fall, and levitate each at will, and have detect magic as a constant spell-like ability. A drow noble can also cast divine favor, dispel magic, and suggestion once per day each. In some cases, a drow noble's spell-like abilities might vary, although the level of a particular spell-like ability does not. A drow noble's caster level for her spell-like abilities is equal to her character level.

entries.name: Duergar
entries.description: Duergar: modificatori {'con': 2, 'wis': 2, 'cha': -4}, taglia Medium, velocita' 20 ft. Tratti razziali: Dwarf; Superior Darkvision; Duergar Immunities; Stability; Spell-Like Abilities; Light Sensitivity.

traits.name: Dwarf
traits.text: Duergar are humanoids with the dwarf subtype.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.text: Duergar can see in the dark up to 120 feet.

traits.name: Duergar Immunities
traits.text: Duergar are immune to paralysis, phantasms, and poison. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Stability
traits.text: Duergar receive a +4 racial bonus to their Combat Maneuver Defense against bull rush or trip attempts while standing on the ground.

traits.name: Spell-Like Abilities
traits.text: A duergar can use enlarge person and invisibility each once per day, using her character level as her caster level and affecting itself only.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Duergar are dazzled in areas of bright light.

entries.name: Duskwalker
entries.description: Duskwalker: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'con': -2, 'wis': 2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Native Outsider; Darkvision; Skilled; Ghost Hunter (Su); Ward against Corruption (Ex).

traits.name: Native Outsider
traits.text: Duskwalkers are outsiders with the native subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Duskwalkers can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Duskwalkers gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (religion) and Heal checks.

traits.name: Ghost Hunter (Su)
traits.text: In a duskwalker’s hands, any weapon can strike true against spectral beings. A duskwalker’s nonmagical weapons deal half damage to incorporeal creatures, as if they were magic weapons, and her magic weapons can deal critical hits and precision damage, even if they do not have the ghost touch property. Once per day as a standard action, a duskwalker can focus her natural revulsion toward undead. If she does so, she treats all weapons she wields as if they had the ghost touch property for 1 minute.

traits.name: Ward against Corruption (Ex)
traits.text: Duskwalkers gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against negative energy and death effects, as well as the spell-like and supernatural abilities of undead and sahkils. They are immune to all abilities that would transform their bodies or souls into undead.

entries.name: Ganzi
entries.description: Ganzi: modificatori {'con': 2, 'cha': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Native Outsider; Darkvision; Maelstrom Resistance; Skilled; Ganzi Oddity.

traits.name: Native Outsider
traits.text: Ganzis are outsiders with the native subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Ganzis can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Maelstrom Resistance
traits.text: Ganzis have acid resistance 5, electricity resistance 5, and sonic resistance 5, and they gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells of the polymorph subschool.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Ganzis gain a +2 racial bonus on Sense Motive and Survival checks.

traits.name: Ganzi Oddity
traits.text: As creatures infused with the entropic forces of the Maelstrom, all ganzis have a distinct and unusual oddity that manifests as a physical or magical ability that sets the ganzi apart. Typically, a ganzi’s oddity is chosen from the most common manifestations of entropy listed below, but other, more unique oddities can certainly exist. The numbers listed for each option can be used to randomly determine what form of ganzi oddity a particular Ganzi might have, at the GM’s option, but the quibble ability is the most common.

entries.name: Gathlain
entries.description: Gathlain: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'cha': 2, 'con': -2}, taglia Small, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Fey; Low-Light Vision; Natural Armor; Spell-Like Abilities.

traits.name: Fey
traits.text: Gathlain are fey.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Gathlains can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Gathlains have a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Spell-Like Abilities
traits.text: 1/day—entangle, feather step (caster level equals the gathlain’s character level).

entries.name: Ghoran
entries.description: Ghoran: modificatori {'con': 2, 'cha': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' None ft. Tratti razziali: Plant; Delicious (Ex); Natural Magic (Sp); Seed (Ex); Light Dependent; Past-Life Knowledge (Ex).

traits.name: Plant
traits.text: Ghorans have the plant type but lack the immunities to mind-affecting, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, and stunning effects that type usually has.

traits.name: Delicious (Ex)
traits.text: Ghorans take a –2 penalty on Escape Artist and combat maneuver checks to escape a grapple against a creature that has a bite attack with the grab ability.

traits.name: Natural Magic (Sp)
traits.text: Ghorans with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day—detect poison, goodberry (created berries bud from the ghoran’s own body), and purify food and drink. The caster level is equal to the ghoran’s level. The DC for these spells is equal to 10 + the spell’s level + the ghoran’s Charisma bonus.

traits.name: Seed (Ex)
traits.text: As a full-round action, a ghoran can expel the seed from an orifice in its abdomen. If planted in fertile ground and left undisturbed for 2d6 days, the seed grows into a healthy duplicate of the original ghoran, save that the duplicate can reallocate all skill ranks upon sprouting. Once a ghoran expels this seed, it gains 1 negative level, and it dies as soon as the duplicate sprouts. This duplicate replaces the previous ghoran character.

traits.name: Light Dependent
traits.text: Ghorans take 1d4 points of Constitution damage each day they go without exposure to sunlight.

traits.name: Past-Life Knowledge (Ex)
traits.text: Ghorans have memories encoded in their seeds. They treat all Knowledge skills as class skills.

entries.name: Gillman
entries.description: Gillman: modificatori {'con': 2, 'cha': 2, 'wis': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Aquatic; Amphibious; Enchantment Resistance; Water Dependent.

traits.name: Aquatic
traits.text: Gillmen are humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Gillmen have the aquatic subtype, but can breathe both water and air.

traits.name: Enchantment Resistance
traits.text: Gillmen gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against non-aboleth enchantment spells and effects, but take a –2 penalty on such saving throws against aboleth sources.

traits.name: Water Dependent
traits.text: A gillman's body requires constant submersion in fresh or salt water. Gillmen who spend more than 1 day without fully submerging themselves in water risk internal organ failure, painful cracking of the skin, and death within 4d6 hours.

entries.name: Green Martian
entries.description: Green Martian: modificatori {'str': 2, 'wis': 2, 'cha': -2}, taglia Large, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Detect Thoughts; Fearless; Ferocity; Multi-Armed; Weapon Familiarity; Skill Training.

traits.name: Detect Thoughts
traits.text: Green Martians possess limited telepathy. allowing them to read the surface thoughts at those around them. they can use detect thoughts as a constant spell-like ability. The caster level of the spell-like ability is equal to the user's character level.

traits.name: Fearless
traits.text: Green Martians gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear eftects.

traits.name: Ferocity
traits.text: If the hit points of a green Martian fall below 0 but it is not yet dead, it can continue to fight. It it does, it is staggered, and loses 1 hit point each round. It still dies when its hit points reach a negative amount equal to its Constitution score.

traits.name: Multi-Armed
traits.text: A green Martian has four arms. One hand is considered its primary hand; all others are considered off hands. It can use any of its hands for other purposes that require free hands.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Green Martians are proficient with longswords and spears.

traits.name: Skill Training
traits.text: Ride and Survival are always considered class skills for green Martians.

entries.name: Grindylow
entries.description: Grindylow: modificatori {'dex': 4, 'int': -2, 'wis': -2, 'cha': -2}, taglia Small, velocita' 15 ft. Tratti razziali: Aberration; Darkvision; Natural Armor; Swim Speed; Jet (1 RP); Bite; Tangling Tentacles (4 RP); Amphibious; Sneaky.

traits.name: Aberration
traits.text: Grindylows are aberrations with the aquatic subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Grindylows have darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Grindylows have tough, rubbery skin that grants a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Swim Speed
traits.text: Grindylows have a swim speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Jet (1 RP)
traits.text: Grindylows can swim 200 feet backward as a full-round action. A grindylow must move in a straight line when jetting and does not provoke attacks of opportunity when using this ability.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Grindylows have a natural bite attack that deals 1d3 points of damage. This bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the creature is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Tangling Tentacles (4 RP)
traits.text: Grindylows have constantly writhing tentacles that reach out to tug at and trip adjacent foes. During the grindylow’s turn, it can make a single trip attack against any adjacent foe as a swift action. The grindylow gains a +4 racial bonus on trip attacks with its tangling tentacles, and if it fails to trip a foe, that creature can’t attempt to trip the grindylow in retaliation.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Grindylows have the aquatic subtype, but they can breathe both water and air.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.text: Grindylows have a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

entries.name: Hobgoblin
entries.description: Hobgoblin: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'con': 2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Goblinoid; Darkvision; Sneaky.

traits.name: Goblinoid
traits.text: Hobgoblins are humanoids with the goblinoid subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Hobgoblins can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.text: Hobgoblins receive a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

entries.name: Ifrit
entries.description: Ifrit: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'cha': 2, 'wis': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Native Outsider; Darkvision; Spell-Like Ability; Energy Resistance; Fire Affinity.

traits.name: Native Outsider
traits.text: Ifrits are outsiders with the native subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Ifrits can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: Ifrits can use burning hands 1/day as a spell-like ability (caster level equals the ifrit’s character level; DC 11 + Charisma modifier).

traits.name: Energy Resistance
traits.text: Ifrits have fire resistance 5.

traits.name: Fire Affinity
traits.text: Ifrit sorcerers with the elemental (fire) bloodline treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for the purposes of all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Ifrit spellcasters with the Fire domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

alternate_traits.name: Wildfire Heart
alternate_traits.description: Ifrits with this trait are as swift and dangerous as a blazing wildfire. They gain a +4 racial bonus on initiative checks. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

alternate_traits.name: Brazen Flame
alternate_traits.description: An unusual number of ifrits hail from the Brazen Peaks area, home to the remains of Xotani the Firebleeder, and their flames infuse their weapons in mortal combat, rather than protect them or grant spells. An ifrit with this racial trait deals 1 point of fire damage with its melee attacks. This racial trait replaces the energy resistance and spell-like ability traits.

alternate_traits.name: Desert Mirage
alternate_traits.description: Ifrits thrive in the deserts of the world, where their keen instincts and resistance to heat give them a huge edge over their competitors. Those with this trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks in desert environments and on saves to resist starvation and thirst. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

alternate_traits.name: Fire in the Blood
alternate_traits.description: Ifrits with this racial trait mimic the healing abilities of the mephits, gaining fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime they take fire damage (whether or not this fire damage gets through their fire resistance). The ifrits can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

alternate_traits.name: Fire Insight
alternate_traits.description: Ifrit spellcasters sometimes find that their elemental heritage makes creatures of fire more willing to serve them. and spells that the ifrit casts last 2 rounds longer than normal when used to summon creatures with the fire subtype. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

alternate_traits.name: Fire-Starter
alternate_traits.description: Ifrits with this racial trait derive sadistic satisfaction from watching others burn. Anytime the ifrit causes a creature to catch fire, he gains a +1 morale bonus on the next single attack roll, saving throw, skill check, or ability check that he makes in the next round. The ifrit only gains this bonus the first time he causes a particular creature to catch fire; subsequent times the creature catches fire provide no bonus. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

alternate_traits.name: Hypnotic
alternate_traits.description: Ifrits with this racial trait evoke the entrancing nature of flame, adding +1 to the DC for all saving throws against spells or effects they cast that inflict the fascinated condition. Once per day, when a creature rolls a saving throw against such an effect from the ifrit, the ifrit can spend an immediate action to force that creature to reroll the saving throw and use the second result, even if it is worse. The ifrit must announce he is using this ability before the results of the first roll are revealed. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

alternate_traits.name: Mostly Human
alternate_traits.description: A few ifrits, oreads, sulis, sylphs, and undines have appearances much closer to those of their human ancestors; in fact, they may not even realize their true race. Such geniekin appear to be human, save perhaps minor features like unusual eye color, and they count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells such as or ). These geniekin do not automatically gain their associated elemental language (but may select it as a bonus language if their Intelligence is high enough). This ability alters the geniekin’s type, subtype, and languages.

alternate_traits.name: Efreeti Magic
alternate_traits.description: Some ifrits inherit an efreeti ancestor’s ability to magically change a creature’s size. They can cast either or (the ifrit chooses when using this ability) once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equals the ifrit’s level). The ifrit can use this ability to affect other ifrits as though they were humanoid creatures. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Forge-Hardened
alternate_traits.description: Not all ifrits are descended from efreet—some instead descend from azers or even salamanders. Such ifrits gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (armor and weapons) checks and saves to resist fatigue and exhaustion. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

entries.name: Kobold
entries.description: Kobold: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'str': -4, 'con': -2}, taglia Small, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Reptilian; Darkvision; Armor; Crafty; Light Sensitivity.

traits.name: Reptilian
traits.text: Kobolds are humanoids with the reptilian subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Kobolds can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Armor
traits.text: Kobolds have a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Crafty
traits.text: Kobolds gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (traps), Perception, and Profession (miner) checks. Craft (traps) and Stealth are always class skills for a kobold.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Kobolds are dazzled as long as they remain in an area of bright light.

entries.name: Kuru
entries.description: Kuru: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'con': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia None, velocita' None ft. Tratti razziali: Low-Light Vision; Blood Courage; Cannibalistic Vitality; Light Sensitivity; Natural Weapon.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: In dim light, kuru can see twice as far as humans.

traits.name: Blood Courage
traits.text: Once per day when a kuru makes a saving throw against a fear effect, he can roll the saving throw twice and take the better result. He must decide to use this ability before the saving throw is attempted.

traits.name: Cannibalistic Vitality
traits.text: When a kuru hits a living creature with its bite attack, he gains 1 temporary hit point by ingesting the target’s blood. This ability does not work on creatures that do not have blood.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Kuru are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.

traits.name: Natural Weapon
traits.text: Kuru possess a natural bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage.

entries.name: Lashunta
entries.description: Lashunta: modificatori {'int': 2}, taglia None, velocita' None ft. Tratti razziali: Sexual Dimorphism; Lashunta Magic; Knowledgeable; Limited Telepathy.

traits.name: Sexual Dimorphism
traits.text: Male and female lashunta have very different body and personality types, more so than most humanoid species. Male lashunta are muscular (+2 Strength) and often brash and unobservant (–2 Wisdom). Female lashunta, though beautiful and commanding (+2 Charisma), lack the males’ rugged builds (–2 Constitution).

traits.name: Lashunta Magic
traits.text: A lashunta possessing an Intelligence score of 11 or higher gains the following spell-like abilities: at will—daze, mage hand; 1/day—detect thoughts. The caster level for these effects is equal to the lashunta’s character level.

traits.name: Knowledgeable
traits.text: A lashunta gains a +2 racial bonus to any one Knowledge skill.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.text: A lashunta is able to mentally communicate with any creature within 30 feet with whom she shares a language. Otherwise this ability is identical to the telepathy ability.

entries.name: Locathah
entries.description: Locathah: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'wis': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 10 ft. Tratti razziali: Aquatic; Low-Light Vision; Natural Armor; Fast Swimmer (5 RP); Amphibious.

traits.name: Aquatic
traits.text: Locathahs are humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Locathahs live in areas where sunlight illuminates the water, and they have low-light vision.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Locathahs have thick scales that provide a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Fast Swimmer (5 RP)
traits.text: Locathahs have a swim speed of 60 feet.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Locathahs have the aquatic subtype but can breathe both water and air.

entries.name: Merfolk
entries.description: Merfolk: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'con': 2, 'cha': 2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 5 ft. Tratti razziali: Aquatic; Amphibious; Low-Light Vision; Armor; Legless.

traits.name: Aquatic
traits.text: Merfolk are humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Merfolk are amphibious, but prefer not to spend long periods out of the water.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Merfolk have low-light vision.

traits.name: Armor
traits.text: Merfolk have a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Legless
traits.text: Merfolk have no legs, and cannot be tripped.

entries.name: Monkey Goblin
entries.description: Monkey Goblin: modificatori {'dex': 4, 'wis': -2, 'cha': -2}, taglia Small, velocita' 20 ft. Tratti razziali: Humanoid; Low-Light Vision; Acrobatic; Fearless; Natural Climber; Prehensile Tail (Ex).

traits.name: Humanoid
traits.text: Monkey goblins are humanoids with the goblinoid subtype.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Monkey goblins can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Acrobatic
traits.text: Monkey goblins gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Stealth checks.

traits.name: Fearless
traits.text: Monkey goblins gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear.

traits.name: Natural Climber
traits.text: Monkey goblins have a climb speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Prehensile Tail (Ex)
traits.text: All monkey goblins have long, flexible tails that they can use to carry objects. They cannot wield weapons with their tails, but the tails do allow them to retrieve small objects stowed on their persons as a swift action.

entries.name: Munavri
entries.description: Munavri: modificatori {'str': -2, 'dex': 4, 'con': 2, 'int': 2, 'wis': 2, 'cha': 2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Darkvision; Light Blindness; Advanced Object Reading (Su); Spell Resistance; Spell-Like Ability; Telepathy (Su).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Munavris have darkvision 120 feet.

traits.name: Light Blindness
traits.text: Munavris have the light blindness universal monster ability.

traits.name: Advanced Object Reading (Su)
traits.text: A munavri can instantly learn how to use almost any device. Once per day, she can select one weapon, suit of armor, or spell trigger item on which she has cast object reading. For a number of minutes equal to her character level, she is considered proficient with that item or can make use of the spell trigger device as if she were a spellcaster of the appropriate class.

traits.name: Spell Resistance
traits.text: A munavri has an amount of spell resistance equal to 8 + her total number of class levels.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: A munavri can cast object reading at will (the caster level is equal to her character level).

traits.name: Telepathy (Su)
traits.text: A munavri is able to mentally communicate with other munavris within 60 feet.

entries.name: Nagaji
entries.description: Nagaji: modificatori {'str': 2, 'cha': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Reptilian; Low-Light Vision; Armored Scales; Resistant; Serpent’s Sense.

traits.name: Reptilian
traits.text: Nagaji are humanoids with the reptilian subtype.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Nagaji can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Armored Scales
traits.text: Nagaji have a +1 natural armor bonus because of their scaly flesh.

traits.name: Resistant
traits.text: Nagaji receive a +2 racial saving throw bonus against mind-affecting effects and poison.

traits.name: Serpent’s Sense
traits.text: Nagaji receive a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks against reptiles, and a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

entries.name: Naiad
entries.description: Naiad: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'cha': 2, 'str': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Low-Light Vision; Fey Nature; Inspiration (Su); Water Bond (Su).

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: All Naiads can see twice as far as humans can in dim light.

traits.name: Fey Nature
traits.text: Naiads have a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal and Knowledge (nature) checks.

traits.name: Inspiration (Su)
traits.text: A naiad can choose another intelligent creature to inspire by giving that creature a token (typically a lock of her hair). As long as the creature carries the naiad’s token and retains her favor, that creature gains a +1 insight bonus on Will saving throws and Craft and Perform checks. The naiad retains a link to her token and its carrier as if she had cast a status spell on the carrier. The naiad can end this effect at any time as a free action. A single naiad can only inspire one other creature at a time in this manner.

traits.name: Water Bond (Su)
traits.text: A naiad gains strength from a pond, lake, river, or other body of fresh water by bonding with it. While within 300 yards of her bonded body of water, she gains a +1 insight bonus to Armor Class and a +1 racial bonus on saving throws (these bonuses are not included in the stats above). Once per day as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, a naiad can forge a bond with a body of fresh water.

bonus: any of the following bonus languages: Aklo

entries.name: Orang-Pendak
entries.description: Orang-Pendak: modificatori {'str': 2, 'wis': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Small, velocita' None ft. Tratti razziali: Type; Forest Walker; Low-Light Vision; Own Two Feet; Simian Empathy; Tear Apart.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Orang-pendaks are humanoids with the sasquatch subtype.

traits.name: Forest Walker
traits.text: Orang-pendaks gain a +4 bonus on Climb and Stealth checks in forests and jungles.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Orang-pendaks can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Own Two Feet
traits.text: Orang-pendaks are extremely unnerved whenever they are riding another creature or on a vehicle, and they take a – 2 penalty on ability checks, attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks when doing so.

traits.name: Simian Empathy
traits.text: Orang-pendaks gain a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal and wild empathy checks with apes and monkeys.

traits.name: Tear Apart
traits.text: Orang-pendaks have powerful upper bodies and gain a +2 racial bonus on Strength checks to break or burst an object. This bonus also applies on combat maneuver checks to sunder with their unarmed attacks.

entries.name: Orc
entries.description: Orc: modificatori {'str': 4, 'int': -2, 'wis': -2, 'cha': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Orc; Darkvision; Light Sensitivity; Ferocity; Weapon Familiarity.

traits.name: Orc
traits.text: Orcs are humanoids with the orc subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Orcs can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Orcs are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.

traits.name: Ferocity
traits.text: Orcs can remain conscious and continue fighting even if their hit point totals fall below 0. Orcs are still staggered at 0 hit points or lower and lose 1 hit point each round as normal.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Orcs are always proficient with greataxes and falchions, and treat any weapon with the word “orc” in its name as a martial weapon.

entries.name: Primitive Human
entries.description: Primitive Human: modificatori {}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Frightened by Magic; Primitive Feat; Savage Skills; Savage Surge.

traits.name: Frightened by Magic
traits.text: Primitive humans are uneasy around magic, especially spells that have large, impressive effects. Whenever a primitive human is damaged or affected by a spell or supernatural ability that has an obvious visual component, the human is shaken for 1 round (subject to GM discretion). A primitive human that gains the ability to cast spells from a class feature is unaffected by this racial trait.

traits.name: Primitive Feat
traits.text: Primitive humans receive Endurance, Fleet, Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, or Toughness as a bonus feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Savage Skills
traits.text: Primitive humans receive a +2 racial bonus on Climb, Survival, and Swim skill checks.

traits.name: Savage Surge
traits.text: Once per day, a primitive human can call upon a well of inner savagery. This grants a +2 bonus to any one Strength-based skill check, Strength check, or weapon damage roll. Using this ability is a free action, but it must be used before the check or attack roll is made.

entries.name: Ratfolk
entries.description: Ratfolk: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'int': 2, 'str': -2}, taglia Small, velocita' 20 ft. Tratti razziali: Ratfolk; Darkvision; Rodent Empathy; Swarming; Tinker.

traits.name: Ratfolk
traits.text: Ratfolk are humanoids with the ratfolk subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Ratfolk can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Rodent Empathy
traits.text: Ratfolk gain a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks made to influence rodents.

traits.name: Swarming
traits.text: Ratfolk are used to living and fighting communally, and are adept at swarming foes for their own gain and their foes’ detriment. Up to two ratfolk can share the same square at the same time. If two ratfolk in the same square attack the same foe, they are considered to be flanking that foe as if they were in two opposite squares.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.text: Ratfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy), Perception, and Use Magic Device checks.

entries.name: Reborn Samsaran
entries.description: Reborn Samsaran: modificatori {'int': 2, 'wis': 2, 'con': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Low-Light Vision; Psychic Attunement; Reborn Magic; Special Qualities.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Reborn samsarans can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Psychic Attunement
traits.text: Reborn samsarans receive Psychic Virtuoso as a bonus feat at 1st level. Those who can’t use occult skill unlocks at 1st level instead gain the Psychic Sensitivity feat as a bonus feat.

traits.name: Reborn Magic
traits.text: A reborn samsaran with a Charisma score of 11 or higher can cast the following spells (as per the psychic magic universal monster rule [see page 2], using his Charisma modifier to determine the DCs): burst of insightOA (1 PE), detect psychic significanceOA (0 PE), object readingOA (2 PE), and psychic readingOA (1 PE). The caster level is equal to the reborn samsaran’s level. The reborn samsaran has a reservoir of 5 PE per day.

traits.name: Special Qualities
traits.text: A reborn samsaran gains the following special qualities.

entries.name: Reptoid
entries.description: Reptoid: modificatori {'str': 2, 'cha': 2, 'dex': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Humanoid; Low-Light Vision (Ex); Scales; Cold-Blooded (Ex); Natural Weapons (Ex); Change Shape (Su); Mental Potency (Ex).

traits.name: Humanoid
traits.text: Reptoids are humanoids with the reptilian and shapechanges subtypes.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision (Ex)
traits.text: Reptoids can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

traits.name: Scales
traits.text: When in its natural form, a reptoid has a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Cold-Blooded (Ex)
traits.text: Reptoids receive a +2 racial saving throw bonus against mind-affecting effects and poison.

traits.name: Natural Weapons (Ex)
traits.text: When in its natural form, a reptoid has a bite attack and two claw attacks that deal 1d3 points of damage each.

traits.name: Change Shape (Su)
traits.text: A reptoid can assume the appearance of a specific single Medium humanoid. The reptoid always takes this specific form when it uses this ability. The reptoid gains a +10 racial bonus on Disguise checks to appear as that type of humanoid. This ability otherwise functions as alter self, except the reptoid does not adjust its ability scores. A reptoid can select a new humanoid form by spending 1 week preparing itself for the change, but can then no longer assume its previous humanoid form.

traits.name: Mental Potency (Ex)
traits.text: A reptoid’s mental effects can affect more powerful creatures or a greater number of creatures than normal. Both the Hit Die limit and the total number of Hit Dice affected by each enchantment or illusion spell it casts increase by 1. For enchantment and illusion spells it casts that target a number of creatures greater than one, the number of creatures affected also increases by one (so a spell that targets one creature per level would be affected, but a spell that targets only one creature would not be). This ability stacks with the mesmerist’s ability of the same name.

entries.name: Rougarou
entries.description: Rougarou: modificatori {'str': 2, 'wis': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Senses; Change Shape (Su); Natural Weapon.

traits.name: Senses
traits.text: Rougarous have low-light vision and the scent special ability.

traits.name: Change Shape (Su)
traits.text: A rougarou can change shape once per day into a wolf as a standard action, as beast shape I. A rougarou can revert to its true form as a swift action.

traits.name: Natural Weapon
traits.text: Rougarous have a bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage. This is a secondary attack if a rougarou wields a manufactured weapon.

auto: their own racial language of Rougarou

entries.name: Sahuagin
entries.description: Sahuagin: modificatori {'str': 2, 'wis': 2, 'cha': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Monstrous Humanoid; Blindsense; Darkvision; Light Blindness; Natural Armor; Fast Swimmer (5 RP); Bite; Claws; Blood Frenzy; Speak with Sharks (1 RP).

traits.name: Monstrous Humanoid
traits.text: Sahuagin are monstrous humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

traits.name: Blindsense
traits.text: Sahuagin have blindsense with a range of 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Sahuagin have darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Light Blindness
traits.text: Sahuagin have the light blindness trait.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Sahuagin have a +3 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Fast Swimmer (5 RP)
traits.text: Sahuagin have a swim speed of 60 feet.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Sahuagin have a natural bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage. This bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the creature is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Sahuagin have two claw attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage. These are primary natural attacks.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: Once per day, whenever a sahuagin takes damage, it can fly into a frenzy for 1 minute; gaining a +2 racial bonus to Constitution and Strength but a –2 penalty to AC.

traits.name: Speak with Sharks (1 RP)
traits.text: Sahuagin can communicate telepathically with sharks to a distance of 100 feet. This communication is limited to simple concepts, such as “attack,” “come,” and “defend.”

alternate_traits.name: Stoic Defender
alternate_traits.description: Outsear sahuagin have learned to control their aggression, standing as reliable guards of the city they are proud to call home. Once per day when a sahuagin with this racial trait takes damage, he can focus on remaining steadfast for the good of Outsea. For 1 minute, the sahuagin gains a +2 racial bonus to AC and a +2 racial bonus on Will saves. This replaces blood frenzy.

alternate_traits.name: Sahuagin Song
alternate_traits.description: While Outsear sahuagin typically don’t have a history of music, over the years the merfolk of the city have shared their love of song with them. Sahuagin with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Perform (sing) checks and a +1 racial bonus on saves against language-dependent effects. This replaces speak with sharks.

entries.name: Skinwalker
entries.description: Skinwalker: modificatori {'wis': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Low-Light Vision; Spell-Like Ability; Animal-Minded; Change Shape (Su).

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Skinwalkers can see twice as far as humans can in dim light.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: A skinwalker with a Wisdom score of 11 or higher can use speak with animals once per day as a spell-like ability, using his Wisdom modifier to determine his concentration checks. The caster level for this ability is equal to the skinwalker's character level.

traits.name: Animal-Minded
traits.text: Skinwalkers have a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks and on wild empathy checks.

traits.name: Change Shape (Su)
traits.text: A skinwalker can change shape to a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to his choice of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a skinwalker assumes bestial form, he can choose to gain two claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage, 60 foot darkvision, or a +1 natural armor bonus. These benefits last until the skinwalker returns to his humanoid form as a swift action. A skinwalker must first return to his humanoid form before changing to bestial form again to change benefits.

subraces.name: Werebat-Kin (Bloodmarked)
subraces.description: Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage +4 racial bonus on Perception checks Scent to a range of 30 feet Treat falling damage as if the distance fallen were 20 feet less than it actually is

subraces.name: Werebear-Kin (Coldborn)
subraces.description: Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage Climb speed of 20 feet Scent to a range of 30 feet

subraces.name: Wereboar-Kin (Ragebred)
subraces.description: +10 foot racial bonus to base speed Gore attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 hoof attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage Scent to a range of 30 feet

subraces.name: Werecrocodile-Kin (Scaleheart)
subraces.description: Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage Darkvision to a range of 60 feet Swim speed of 30 feet

subraces.name: Wereraptor-Kin (Aerieborn)
subraces.description: Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 talon attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage +4 racial bonus on Perception checks Increase fly speeds from other sources by 10 feet

subraces.name: Wererat-Kin (Nightskulk)
subraces.description: Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage Climb speed of 30 feet (except with only one chosen natural attack per round, and sickens instead of nauseates). Scent to a range of 30 feet

subraces.name: Wereshark-Kin (Seascarred)
subraces.description: Breathe water as well as air Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage Swim speed of 30 feet

subraces.name: Weretiger-Kin (Fanglord)
subraces.description: Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage +10-foot racial bonus to base speed

subraces.name: Werewolf-Kin (Witchwolf)
subraces.description: Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage Darkvision 60 feet +2 racial bonus on all saving throws

alternate_traits.name: Beast Talker
replaces: Alters Change Shape and Spell-like Ability

entries.name: Svirfneblin
entries.description: Svirfneblin: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'wis': 2, 'str': -2, 'cha': -4}, taglia Small, velocita' 20 ft. Tratti razziali: Gnome; Defensive Training; Senses; Fortunate; Skilled; Hatred; Stonecunning; Spell Resistance; Svirfneblin Magic.

traits.name: Gnome
traits.text: Svirfneblin are humanoids with the gnome subtype.

traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 dodge bonus to their AC.

traits.name: Senses
traits.text: Svirfneblin have darkvision 120 feet and lowlight vision.

traits.name: Fortunate
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks; this improves to a +4 bonus underground. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks and Perception checks.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Svirfneblin receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain the stonecunning trait as dwarves.

traits.name: Spell Resistance
traits.text: A svirfneblin has an amount of spell resistance equal to 11 + his character level.

traits.name: Svirfneblin Magic
traits.text: Svirfneblin add 1 to the DCs of any saving throws to resist illusion spells they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: constant—nondetection; 1/day—blindness/deafness (DC 12 + Charisma modifier), blur, disguise self; caster level equals the svirfneblin’s character level.

entries.name: Syrinx
entries.description: Syrinx: modificatori {'wis': 2, 'dex': -2}, taglia None, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Flight; Low-Light Vision; Darkvision; Nocturnal; Pride; Speak with Avians.

traits.name: Flight
traits.text: Syrinxes have a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Syrinxes can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Syrinxes can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Nocturnal
traits.text: Syrinxes gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks at night.

traits.name: Pride
traits.text: Syrinxes receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

traits.name: Speak with Avians
traits.text: Syrinxes can speak with all birds of the animal creature type and birdlike magical beasts (such as phoenixes and thunderbirds).

entries.name: Triaxian
entries.description: Triaxian: modificatori {'con': 2, 'wis': 2, 'str': -2}, taglia None, velocita' None ft. Tratti razziali: Low-Light Vision; Keen Senses; Bonus Feat; Seasoned.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: In dim light, Triaxians can see twice as far as humans.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Triaxians’ unique ear construction grants them a +2 bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Bonus Feat
traits.text: Triaxians select one extra feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Seasoned
traits.text: Summerborn Triaxians can exist comfortably in conditions between 90 and 140 degrees Fahrenheit without having to attempt Fortitude saves. Winterborn Triaxians can exist comfortably in conditions between 40 and –20 degrees Fahrenheit without having to attempt Fortitude saves. When in conditions of severe cold or heat, Triaxians have to attempt Fortitude saves only once per hour instead of once every 10 minutes. Transitional Triaxians do not have this ability.

auto: Triaxian (the common trade language of Triaxus)

entries.name: Triton
entries.description: Triton: modificatori {'str': 2, 'cha': 2, 'dex': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 5 ft. Tratti razziali: Outsider; Darkvision; Low-Light Vision; Natural Armor; Swim Speed; Spell-Like Ability.

traits.name: Outsider
traits.text: Tritons are native outsiders with the water subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Tritons have darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Tritons have low-light vision.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Tritons have a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Swim Speed
traits.text: Tritons have a swim speed of 40 feet.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: Tritons can cast summon nature’s ally II once per day to summon either a Small water elemental or 1d3 dolphins only.

entries.name: Trox
entries.description: Trox: modificatori {'str': 6, 'int': -2, 'wis': -2, 'cha': -2}, taglia Large, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Monstrous Humanoid; Darkvision; Burrow; Frenzy; Grabbing Appendages.

traits.name: Monstrous Humanoid
traits.text: Trox are monstrous humanoids.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Trox can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Burrow
traits.text: Trox have a burrow speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Frenzy
traits.text: Once per day when a trox takes damage, it flies into a frenzy for 1 minute, gaining a +2 racial bonus to Constitution and Strength, but a –2 penalty to their AC.

traits.name: Grabbing Appendages
traits.text: A trox’s smaller arms are useful for little more than aiding it with grappling. Trox gain Improved Grapple as a bonus feat, and can maintain a grapple and still make attacks with their main arms.

entries.name: Undine
entries.description: Undine: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'wis': 2, 'str': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Native Outsider; Darkvision; Spell-Like Ability; Energy Resistance; Water Affinity.

traits.name: Native Outsider
traits.text: Undines are outsiders with the native subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Undines can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: Undines can cast hydraulic push once per day as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to the undine’s character level).

traits.name: Energy Resistance
traits.text: Undines have cold resistance 5.

traits.name: Water Affinity
traits.text: Undine sorcerers with the elemental (water) bloodline treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for the purposes of all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Undine clerics with the Water domain cast their Water domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

alternate_traits.name: Deepsight
alternate_traits.description: The eyes of some undines are especially adapted to the lightless depths of the oceans, but not to air-filled environments. An undine with this racial trait has darkvision 120 feet when underwater, but otherwise has no darkvision at all. This racial trait replaces darkvision.

alternate_traits.name: Flesh Chameleon
alternate_traits.description: Some undines can change their coloration to match human skin tones. As a standard action, an undine with this racial trait can change her natural blue hue to match any normal human skin tone, and can revert to normal as a free action. This grants a +4 racial bonus on Disguise checks to appear human. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

alternate_traits.name: Terrain Chameleon
alternate_traits.description: Some undines can change their coloration to blend in with underwater terrain, mixing browns, grays, and greens to resemble kelp or other natural water plants. As a standard action, an undine with this racial trait can change her coloration, gaining a +4 bonus on Stealth checks in underwater environments. She can return to normal as a free action. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

alternate_traits.name: Water Sense
alternate_traits.description: Undines with this racial trait can sense vibrations in water, granting them blindsense 30 feet against creatures in contact with the same body of water. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

alternate_traits.name: Mostly Human
alternate_traits.description: A few ifrits, oreads, sulis, sylphs, and undines have appearances much closer to those of their human ancestors; in fact, they may not even realize their true race. Such geniekin appear to be human, save perhaps minor features like unusual eye color, and they count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells such as or ). These geniekin do not automatically gain their associated elemental language (but may select it as a bonus language if their Intelligence is high enough). This ability alters the geniekin’s type, subtype, and languages.

alternate_traits.name: Acid Breath
alternate_traits.description: Undines whose outsider heritage can be traced to a water mephit can wield acid as a weapon. Such an undine has a breath weapon that is a 5-foot cone of acidic water usable once per day. The breath deals 1d8 points of acid damage per two character levels (maximum 5d8). A Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine’s level + the undine’s Constitution modifier) halves the damage. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Amphibious
alternate_traits.description: Some undines are born with a permanent bond to water. Undines with this racial trait gain the aquatic subtype and amphibious special quality. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Nereid Fascination
alternate_traits.description: Some undines can trace their ancestry to nereids as well as to outsiders. Once per day as a standard action, such an undine can create a 20-foot-radius aura that causes humanoids within the aura’s range to become fascinated with her for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 the undine’s character level (minimum 1). Targets may resist with a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine’s level + the undine’s Charisma modifier). This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Ooze Breath
alternate_traits.description: Some undines’ outsider heritage can be traced to ooze mephits. These undines have a breath weapon that is a 5-foot cone of slime usable once per day. The slime deals 1d4 points of acid damage per two character levels (maximum 5d4) and sickens creatures in the area for 3 rounds. A successful Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine’s level + the undine’s Constitution modifier) halves the damage and negates the sickened effect. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Triton Magic
alternate_traits.description: Some undines—often from Outsea—descend from tritons, rather than genies. Undines with this racial trait can use as a spell-like ability, but only to summon a dolphin. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Hydrated Vitality
alternate_traits.description: An undine with this racial trait gains fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime she submerges completely within a body of natural salt water, fresh water, or brackish water. Stagnant, poisoned, or trapped water (such as an artificial pit or a ) does not activate this ability. The undine can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces water affinity.

entries.name: Vine Leshy
entries.description: Vine Leshy: modificatori {'con': 2, 'wis': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Small, velocita' 20 ft. Tratti razziali: Leshy; Darkvision; Low-Light Vision; Pass without Trace; Change Shape; Plantspeech; Verdant Burst; Unassuming Foliage; Climber.

traits.name: Leshy
traits.text: Vine leshys are plants with the leshy subtype but lack the immunities to mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, and stunning that the plant type usually grants, and they lack the immunity to electricity and sonic that the leshy subtype usually grants.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Vine leshys can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Vine leshys can see twice as far as humans under conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Pass without Trace
traits.text: Vine leshys have pass without trace as a constant spell-like ability (caster level 2nd).

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: Vine leshys can transform into vines, with results similar to tree shape. In this form, the leshy appears as a particularly healthy Small vine. The leshy can assume plant form or revert to its true form as a swift action.

traits.name: Plantspeech
traits.text: Vine leshys can speak with vines as if subject to a continual speak with plants spell.

traits.name: Verdant Burst
traits.text: When slain, a vine leshy explodes in a burst of fertile energies. All plant creatures within 30 feet of the slain leshy regain hit 1d8 points, and vines quickly infest the area. If the terrain can support vines, the undergrowth is dense enough to make the region into difficult terrain for 24 hours, after which the plant life diminishes to a normal level; otherwise, this plant life has no significant effect on movement and withers and dies within an hour.

traits.name: Unassuming Foliage
traits.text: Vine leshys gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in forests.

traits.name: Climber
traits.text: Vine leshys gain a +2 racial bonus on Climb checks.

traits.text: Yaddithians can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Defensive Abilities
traits.text: Yaddithians have cold resistance 5 and the no breath ability.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: A Yaddithian has two claws that deal 1d4 points of damage each.

traits.name: Rugose
traits.text: A Yaddithian gains a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Cosmic Mind (Ex)
traits.text: A Yaddithian gets a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge and Spellcraft checks. A yaddithian spellcaster who would store spells in a spellbook or familiar instead stores those spells in its mind (but must expend the normal resources to learn new spells).

traits.name: Long-Lived (Ex)
traits.text: Yaddithians live for thousands of years; they gain no benefit or penalty from aging and are immune to magical aging effects.
